Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

47	func (p *IdentityProvider) ExchangeToken(ctx context.Context, redirectURL, code, codeVerifier string) (string, error) {
48		conf := &oauth2.Config{
49			ClientID:     p.config.ClientId,
50			ClientSecret: p.config.ClientSecret,
51			RedirectURL:  redirectURL,

103		for _, provider := range state.IdentityProviders {

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)

112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135	
136		identifierFilter := identityProvider.IdentifierFilter
137		if identifierFilter != "" {
138			identifierFilterRegex, err := regexp.Compile(identifierFilter)
139			if err != nil {
140				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to compile identifier filter regex, error: %v", err)

143				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "identifier %s is not allowed", userInfo.Identifier)
144			}
145		}
146	
147		return identityProvider, userInfo, nil

31			if err := s.clearAuthCookies(ctx); err != nil {
32				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clear auth cookies: %v", err)

34			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not found")
35		}

42	// SignIn authenticates a user with credentials and returns tokens.

44	//

47	// 2. SSO authentication (OAuth2 authorization code).
48	//
49	// Authentication: Not required (public endpoint).
50	// Returns: User info, access token, and token expiry.
51	func (s *APIV1Service) SignIn(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.SignInRequest) (*v1pb.SignInResponse, error) {
52		var existingUser *store.User
53	
54		// Authentication Method 1: Password-based authentication
55		if passwordCredentials := request.GetPasswordCredentials(); passwordCredentials != nil {
56			user, err := s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{
57				Username: &passwordCredentials.Username,
58			})
59			if err != nil {
60				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user, error: %v", err)
61			}
62			if user == nil {
63				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, unmatchedUsernameAndPasswordError)
64			}
65			// Compare the stored hashed password, with the hashed version of the password that was received.
66			if err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(user.PasswordHash), []byte(passwordCredentials.Password)); err != nil {
67				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, unmatchedUsernameAndPasswordError)
68			}
69			instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
70			if err != nil {
71				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
72			}
73			// Check if the password auth in is allowed.
74			if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowPasswordAuth && user.Role == store.RoleUser {
75				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "password signin is not allowed")
76			}
77			existingUser = user
78		} else if ssoCredentials := request.GetSsoCredentials(); ssoCredentials != nil {
79			// Authentication Method 2: SSO (OAuth2) authentication
80			identityProvider, userInfo, err := s.resolveSSOIdentity(ctx, ssoCredentials.IdpName, ssoCredentials.Code, ssoCredentials.RedirectUri, ssoCredentials.CodeVerifier)

83			}

86				return nil, err

93		}
94		if existingUser.RowStatus == store.Archived {
95			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user has been archived with username %s", existingUser.Username)

98		accessToken, accessExpiresAt, err := s.doSignIn(ctx, existingUser)
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to sign in: %v", err)
101		}

105			AccessToken:          accessToken,
106			AccessTokenExpiresAt: timestamppb.New(accessExpiresAt),

15	// ErrUnsafeAuthenticationConfiguration indicates a mutation would lock regular users out.

32	func (s *Store) UpsertInstanceGeneralSettingSafely(ctx context.Context, setting *storepb.InstanceSetting) (*storepb.InstanceSetting, error) {
33		if setting == nil || setting.Key != storepb.InstanceSettingKey_GENERAL || setting.GetGeneralSetting() == nil {
34			return nil, errors.New("GENERAL instance setting is required")
35		}
36		value, err := protojson.Marshal(setting.GetGeneralSetting())
37		if err != nil {

39		}
40		raw := &InstanceSetting{Name: storepb.InstanceSettingKey_GENERAL.String(), Value: string(value)}
41		mutation := &AuthenticationConfigMutation{
42			UpsertGeneralSetting: raw,
43			Validate: func(state *AuthenticationConfigState) error {
44				return s.validateAuthenticationMutationState(state, setting.GetGeneralSetting(), nil)
45			},
46		}
47		if err := s.applyAuthenticationConfigMutation(ctx, mutation); err != nil {
48			return nil, err

50		result := cloneInstanceSetting(setting)

70		s.authConfigMu.Lock()
71		defer s.authConfigMu.Unlock()
72	
73		var err error
74		for attempt := 0; attempt < authenticationMutationMaxAttempts; attempt++ {
75			err = s.driver.ApplyAuthenticationConfigMutation(ctx, mutation)
76			if err == nil || !s.driver.IsRetryableAuthenticationMutationError(err) {
77				return err
78			}
79			select {
80			case <-ctx.Done():
81				return ctx.Err()
82			case <-time.After(time.Duration(attempt+1) * 10 * time.Millisecond):
83			}
84		}
85		return errors.Wrap(err, "authentication configuration mutation failed after retries")

88	func (s *Store) validateAuthenticationMutationState(state *AuthenticationConfigState, proposedGeneral *storepb.InstanceGeneralSetting, deletedProviderID *int32) error {
89		var storedGeneral *storepb.InstanceGeneralSetting
90		if state.GeneralSetting != nil {
91			stored, err := convertInstanceSettingFromRaw(state.GeneralSetting)
92			if err != nil {
93				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to decode stored GENERAL setting")
94			}
95			storedGeneral = stored.GetGeneralSetting()
96		}
97	
98		storedUIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.IdentityProviders))
99		for _, provider := range state.IdentityProviders {
100			storedUIDs[provider.UID] = struct{}{}
101		}
102		effectiveUIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.IdentityProviders))
103		for _, provider := range state.IdentityProviders {
104			if deletedProviderID != nil && provider.ID == *deletedProviderID {
105				continue
106			}
107			effectiveUIDs[provider.UID] = struct{}{}
108		}
109		for _, provider := range s.listDeploymentIdentityProviders() {
110			effectiveUIDs[provider.Uid] = struct{}{}
111		}

118			if isUnsafeAuthenticationState(proposedGeneral, storedUIDs) && !isUnsafeAuthenticationState(storedGeneral, storedUIDs) {
119				return ErrUnsafeAuthenticationConfiguration
120			}
121			return nil
122		}
123	
124		oldGeneral := storedGeneral
125		if configuredGeneral != nil {
126			oldGeneral = configuredGeneral.GetGeneralSetting()
127		}
128		newGeneral := oldGeneral
129		if proposedGeneral != nil {
130			newGeneral = proposedGeneral
131		}
132	
133		oldEffectiveUIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(storedUIDs))
134		for uid := range storedUIDs {
135			oldEffectiveUIDs[uid] = struct{}{}
136		}
137		for _, provider := range s.listDeploymentIdentityProviders() {
138			oldEffectiveUIDs[provider.Uid] = struct{}{}
139		}
140		if isUnsafeAuthenticationState(newGeneral, effectiveUIDs) && !isUnsafeAuthenticationState(oldGeneral, oldEffectiveUIDs) {
141			return ErrUnsafeAuthenticationConfiguration
142		}

19	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, identityProvider *storepb.IdentityProvider, userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo) (*store.User, error) {
20		provider := identityProvider.Uid
21		externUID := userInfo.Identifier
22	
23		user, err := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		if user != nil {
28			if currentUser != nil && currentUser.ID != user.ID {
29				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
30			}
31			return user, nil
32		}
33	
34		if currentUser != nil {
35			return s.bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx, currentUser, provider, externUID)
36		}
37	
38		// Miss path: enforce the registration gate before creating anything.
39		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
40		if err != nil {
41			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
42		}
43		if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
44			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
45		}
46	
47		password, err := util.RandomString(20)
48		if err != nil {
49			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate random password, error: %v", err)
50		}
51		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash, error: %v", err)
54		}
55		username, err := deriveSSOUsername()
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to derive username, error: %v", err)
58		}
59		user, err = s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
60			Username:     username,
61			Role:         store.RoleUser,
62			Nickname:     userInfo.DisplayName,
63			Email:        userInfo.Email,
64			AvatarURL:    userInfo.AvatarURL,
65			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
66		})
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user, error: %v", err)
69		}
70	
71		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
72			UserID:    user.ID,
73			Provider:  provider,
74			ExternUID: externUID,
75		}); err != nil {
76			// Best-effort cleanup: the provisional user row has no linkage and should not remain.
77			_, _ = s.Store.DeleteUser(ctx, &store.DeleteUser{ID: user.ID})
78			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
79				// Concurrent first login won the race; load the winning linkage's user.
80				winner, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
81					Provider:  &provider,
82					ExternUID: &externUID,
83				})
84				if getErr != nil {
85					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload user identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
86				}
87				if winner == nil {
88					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
89				}
90				winnerUser, getErr := s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &winner.UserID})
91				if getErr != nil {
92					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user after race, error: %v", getErr)
93				}
94				if winnerUser == nil {
95					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "linked user %d not found after race", winner.UserID)
96				}
97				return winnerUser, nil
98			}
99			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
100		}
101		return user, nil
102	}

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid identity provider name: %v", err)
108		}
109		identityProvider, err := s.Store.GetIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{
110			UID: &idpUID,
111		})
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135	
136		identifierFilter := identityProvider.IdentifierFilter
137		if identifierFilter != "" {
138			identifierFilterRegex, err := regexp.Compile(identifierFilter)
139			if err != nil {
140				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to compile identifier filter regex, error: %v", err)
141			}
142			if !identifierFilterRegex.MatchString(userInfo.Identifier) {
143				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "identifier %s is not allowed", userInfo.Identifier)
144			}
145		}
146	
147		return identityProvider, userInfo, nil
148	}

171	func (s *APIV1Service) bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, provider, externUID string) (*store.User, error) {
172		existingForProvider, err := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
173			UserID:   &currentUser.ID,
174			Provider: &provider,
175		})
176		if err != nil {
177			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get existing linked identity, error: %v", err)
178		}
179		if existingForProvider != nil {
180			if existingForProvider.ExternUID == externUID {
181				return currentUser, nil
182			}
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider is already linked to another external account for this user")
184		}
185	
186		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
187			UserID:    currentUser.ID,
188			Provider:  provider,
189			ExternUID: externUID,
190		}); err != nil {
191			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
192				winner, getErr := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
193				if getErr != nil {
194					return nil, getErr
195				}
196				if winner != nil {
197					if winner.ID != currentUser.ID {
198						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
199					}
200					return currentUser, nil
201				}
202	
203				existingForProvider, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
204					UserID:   &currentUser.ID,
205					Provider: &provider,
206				})
207				if getErr != nil {
208					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload linked identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
209				}
210				if existingForProvider != nil {
211					if existingForProvider.ExternUID == externUID {
212						return currentUser, nil
213					}
214					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider is already linked to another external account for this user")
215				}
216	
217				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
218			}
219			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
220		}
221		return currentUser, nil
222	}

224	// isUniqueConstraintViolation matches the driver-specific error messages that each
225	// supported backend emits when any UNIQUE constraint rejects an insert. Callers
226	// disambiguate which constraint was hit from the insertion context (e.g. inserting
227	// a user_identity row can only violate UNIQUE(provider, extern_uid); inserting a
228	// user row can only violate UNIQUE(username)). Matches the pattern used in
229	// memo_service.go for the memo UID unique check.
230	func isUniqueConstraintViolation(err error) bool {
231		if err == nil {
232			return false
233		}
234		msg := err.Error()
235		return strings.Contains(msg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
236			strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate key") ||
237			strings.Contains(msg, "Duplicate entry")
238	}

54		// Authentication Method 1: Password-based authentication

66			if err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(user.PasswordHash), []byte(passwordCredentials.Password)); err != nil {

68			}

70			if err != nil {
